name: tag-manager
description: Create custom text tags that anyone can recall with /tag.

configFields.label: Enabled
configFields.description: Turn tag lookups on or off without disabling the whole addon.

configFields.label: Max Tags
configFields.description: Maximum number of tags this server can store.

configFields.label: Not Found Message
configFields.description: Shown when a looked-up tag doesn't exist.

configFields.label: Trigger Mode
configFields.description: 'exact' matches the tag name exactly; 'contains' matches if the name appears anywhere in the input.

configFields.label: Log Channel
configFields.description: Optional channel to post a message whenever a tag is created or deleted.
